name: Yandere Kanojo
source:
From here on, a tale filled with madness begins.
How did it come to this?..
Who truly desires this world?..
Can you find the answers?
In a world spiraling into madness, a twisted love mystery sound novel unfolds.
 
"Now, let’s reach a happy ending in our world of just the two of us."

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20061]freem[/url]]
translation:
自此，一个充满疯狂的故事开始了。
怎么就变成这样了呢？…
谁真正渴望这个世界？
你能找到答案吗？
在一个陷入疯狂的世界中，一部扭曲的爱情悬疑声音小说展开。
 
“现在，让我们在只有我们两个人的世界里达成一个幸福的结局吧。”

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20061]freem[/url]]
